Decisions

  • All decisions
  • 0001 · Shared C++ engine behind a C API
  • 0002 · Four output topologies; Bluetooth is master only
  • 0003 · Obsidian is the default design system; users can change its look
  • 0004 · Split is the primary mark; Pulse is a supporting element
  • 0005 · Adopt Station 1.2.1 as an internal, small-shape repository
  • 0006 · Automatic transitions start on the next phrase
  • 0007 · One shared library; named sessions; imports copied in
  • 0008 · A vinyl platter model in the engine

QA

Automated

make validate runs, in order:

StepCommandFails when
Dependency pinsnode tools/deps/check.mjsA Gradle version is dynamic (+, ranges, latest), or Package.swift gains a dependency without Package.resolved
Design tokenspython3 design/tokens/generate.py --checkSwift, CSS or DESIGN.md differ from the token JSON
Sitenode tools/site/build.mjs --checkpublic/ or index.html differ from what the generator writes
Dev loginsnode tools/logins/check.jsA default in code or config is missing from dev-logins.md
Typecheckengine build with -Werror; swift build on macOS; node --check on toolsAny compile error or engine warning
Lintnode tools/station/check.mjsThe Station layout, manifest, version agreement, README shape, job files or links are wrong
Testsctest; swift test on macOSAny test fails

make e2e checks the built site: every page opens, every relative link and asset resolves, every in-page anchor exists. make shots retakes docs/screenshot.png with headless Chrome.

Sanitizers

cmake -S engine -B build-asan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-sanitize-recover=all"
cmake --build build-asan -j && ./build-asan/sbe_tests
cmake -S engine -B build-tsan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=thread"
cmake --build build-tsan -j && ./build-tsan/sbe_tests concurrent

CI runs both (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

On-device validation matrix

Run Routing Lab in each configuration. Confirm by ear and by the meters that the high cue chirp never reaches the speakers, with no glitches over 30 minutes. Record p99 render time, xruns, actual buffer size and reported latency per row in job 007.

DeviceConfigurations
iPhone (USB-C)speaker · USB-C to 3.5 mm + splitter · USB DAC + headphones (multi-route) · 4-channel controller · Bluetooth speaker
iPhone (Lightning)Lightning to 3.5 mm + splitter · camera-kit USB interface
Android: Pixel, Samsung, one low-cost devicespeaker + headset probe · USB-C dongle + splitter · 4-channel controller · Bluetooth A2DP · LE Audio
Mac (Apple silicon)built-in + headphone jack (two devices) · USB interface · Bluetooth speaker master + wired cue

Before a release

  1. make validate and make e2e green.
  2. Matrix rows touched by the change re-run on hardware.
  3. Light and dark (OLED, Graphite, Daylight) checked on a phone and a Mac.
  4. make shots, make site, make dist; fresh-checkout test from the zip.
